C_generic.question: Dammi gli strain che hanno ineva uguale a true e collectiondate con una data successiva al 2020
sql_query_variants: SELECT * FROM detailedstrain WHERE ineva = True AND ((LENGTH(collectiondate) = 10 AND SUBSTR(collectiondate, 7, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(collectiondate, 4, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(collectiondate, 1, 2) > '2020-12-31') OR (LENGTH(collectiondate) = 4 AND collectiondate > '2020'));

C_generic.question: Quali sono gli strain che hanno il genus diverso da Nocardioides e species uguale ad ambifaria?

C_generic.question: Show me the accessionumber field of the strains with isolate date after 1998-02-14
sql_query_variants: SELECT accessionnumber FROM detailedstrain WHERE (LENGTH(collectiondate) = 10 AND SUBSTR(collectiondate, 7, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(collectiondate, 4, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(collectiondate, 1, 2) > '1998-02-14') OR (LENGTH(collectiondate) = 4 AND collectiondate >= '1998');

C_generic.question: Tell me how many strains have applications equal to Agroindustry and group them by species field
sql_query_variants: SELECT COUNT(*), species FROM detailedstrain WHERE applications = 'Agroindustry' GROUP BY species;
